description: Install MicroPython on a Pico in BOOTSEL mode or a supported ESP32 in DOWNLOAD mode. Always call action check first. A Pico may require mounting and a Wi-Fi model choice. An ESP32 uses the detected chip-specific generic build. Obtain explicit confirmation before calling action install.

board_id.description: Stable board UID returned by pico_boards_list, or its current serial device path.

confirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly confirms installation.

initialize_storage.description: Erase and initialize ESP32 filesystem storage during installation. Defaults to true for ESP32.

wifi.description: Whether a Pico is a W model with Wi-Fi. Required only for Pico installation.

name: pico_install
title: Install firmware on a bootloader-mode board
